title: Account projects
intro: Open a project from your account. Projects on this computer stay where they are.
addressHelp: Use the HTTPS address, without a path.
waiting: Approve this connection in your browser
match: Enter this code in your browser, then come back here.
unlockHelp: Use the passphrase that unlocks your account projects. It is not sent to the server.
invalid: Enter the account server’s HTTPS address without a path.
unavailable: The account server did not answer as expected. Check the address and try again.
expired: This connection is no longer available. Start a new one.
noSavedConnection: No saved sign-in is available. Connect in your browser again.
unsupported: This server does not accept desktop connections.
missing: Set up your encryption passphrase in the browser before opening projects here.
rotating: Finish replacing the recovery key in the browser, then unlock here.
wrongPassphrase: These projects could not be unlocked. Check your passphrase and try again.
signedOut: This account session ended. Connect again to open your projects.
signOutFailed: Your saved sign-in could not be removed. Try signing out again.
listFailed: Could not read your projects. Try unlocking again.
unreadable: Some projects could not be opened with this account key.
noProjects: There are no projects yet. Create one on your account in the browser.
openFailed: Could not open this project. Try again.
elsewhere: This project is open for editing on another device.
offline: The edit lease expired while offline. Your pending edits stay on this device until you send them.
